name: Public Office Simulator
desc:
Complete your tasks, grab some coffee, and strike up some awkward small talk by the water cooler!

If you want to support the games development, consider giving the game a Like & a Favourite! It's free and you can always change your mind. :)

Level tags: 100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10,000, 50,000 100,000, 250,000, 1,000,000

* 1 level every minute
* 5 points every 20 seconds

WARNING: 
Your account must be at least 30 days old to play this game. 
Do not conduct any activity against Roblox TOS otherwise it will be moderated. 
If you dislike loud boomboxes you can mute them in settings, this also applies for the game music, tool sounds ect.
